Well, at one time we had a guy by the name of, small guy, tenor player, by the name of Bill Moore and Bill Moore used to do this specialty in front of the band, too, just Bill Moore and myself and sometimes when time warrants, like if there's time to -- there's certain amount of minutes in each show, stage show that if there's too many acts I wouldn't get a chance to do my solo. But most of the time I would do my solo, whatever I would do. I was a part of the Armstrong unit. I would either do the show or, you…

I see. Well, early -- well, in the spring, as a matter of fact March 12, 1947, you realize that's two days and 33 years from today that the orchestra recorded "I wonder, I wonder," and "I Believe," "Why Doubt My Love," "It Takes Time," and "You Don't Learn That in School."
